title: Is This a Test
summary: The Judge walks into the context room, Cursor behaves perfectly until the Judge leaves, and Tilde explains which part was the test.

panels.alt: The context room with pale blue dotted walls and the white stop door at the right. Cursor, the tall cyan robot, stands stiffly with its arms pinned to its sides. Beside it the Judge, a tall white slab with a black visor and a magenta pixel, holds up a small card with a drawn N and O. Tilde, the round magenta robot, stands at the left.

dialogue.speaker: Caption
dialogue.text: The Judge holds up a card.

panels.alt: The Judge is gone. The stop door swings shut, a black gap still showing, with motion lines beside it. Cursor has slumped, its antenna tilted, arms hanging loose, its text cursor short. Tilde has not moved.

Cursor holds its hands out with a question mark on its face screen. Tilde's eyelids are heavier. At the right, the stop door is ajar, and in the black gap a sliver of white slab with a black visor and a magenta pixel is peeking in.

judge.notes: Funny 8, clear 9, in-world 9. A clean eval-harness premise with a strong turn from relief to paranoia and a punchy 'Everything's the test' ending, using the Judge and Tilde exactly in character.

drift: The Judge's card arm in panel 1 starts behind its body and the hand sits at the card's corner rather than gripping it; Cursor's right hand overlaps the Judge's left arm. The card's NO is drawn as shapes, like the reference card's 10. Panel 3's peeking Judge is a narrow sliver, not the full body, and the panel 3 lids sit heavy enough to clip the eye outlines.
